statement.zh: 将塔西安简单定为「早于巴达里的独立文化阶段」仍属可修订的年代—文化模型，须对照后续中埃及层位研究。
statement.en: Treating Tasian simply as an independent phase earlier than Badarian remains a revisable chrono-cultural model pending later Middle Egypt stratigraphic work.

disclaimer: Hypothesis / scholarly model — not established fact. Labelled kind=hypothesis.

editorial.notes: Paraphrased from cited registered sources only.
